sloka: इदम् आKयनम् आयुश्यम् गंगा अवतरणम् शुभम् ॥१-४४-२२॥
transliteration: idam āKyanam āyuśyam gaṁgā avataraṇam śubham ॥1-44-22॥

translations.english: O Son of the Kakusthas whosoever listens to this auspicious story relating to the descent of Ganga with concentration, all his desires will be achieved, his sins will be destroyed and his longevity and fame will increase". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: हे महारथी भगीरथ ! तेरा मनोरथ है तो बड़ा, किन्तु वह वू होगा अर्थात्‌ तुमे पुत्र की प्राप्ति होगी । हे इच्चाकुकुलवर्धन ! तेरा मङ्गल हो
